entries.0cc0350f4ae9473e: A reportable segment engaged in railway and bus operations. Operating revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥44,375 million (¥42,890 million in the previous fiscal year). Railways are operated by Sagami Railway Co., Ltd., and buses by Sotetsu Bus Co., Ltd. This segment comprises 2 companies (as of March 31, 2026). The group runs businesses closely tied to life in the areas along its railway lines, centered on the railway business.
entries.181ce13930c273d5: A reportable segment engaged in real estate sales, real estate leasing and other businesses. Operating revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥68,798 million (¥66,934 million in the previous fiscal year). Sales are handled by Sotetsu Real Estate Co., Ltd. and Sotetsu Real Estate Sales Co., Ltd., and leasing by Sotetsu Urban Creates Co., Ltd. and Sotetsu Building Management Co., Ltd. This segment comprises 8 companies (as of March 31, 2026).
